# Masar X

> Masar X is an Arabic-first (RTL) university learning platform built with Next.js + Supabase, providing study summaries, quizzes, courses, and AI-assisted study tools.

Key notes for LLMs/agents:

- The frontend is a Next.js 14 App Router project (TypeScript + TailwindCSS) under `src/app` and shared UI under `src/components`.
- The backend is Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions). Client code uses the Supabase JS client; privileged operations are handled via Edge Functions.
- Users may be redirected to academic onboarding (level/semester selection) if missing profile academic data.

## Project docs

- [README](./README.md): Overview, features, tech stack.
- [Setup guide](./SETUP.md): Full local setup, env vars, Supabase migrations, deployment notes.

## Key app routes

- [Home](/): Main landing/dashboard.
- [Subjects](/subjects): Subject list (semester-based).
- [Courses](/courses): Course catalog and enrollment.
- [Quizzes](/quizzes): Quiz browsing and attempts.
- [AI assistant](/ai-assistant): Gemini-powered assistant UI.
- [Academic onboarding](/onboarding/academic): Level/semester selection (shown when required).

## Supabase (backend)

- [Edge functions (source)](/supabase/functions): Deno-based functions (e.g. chat, uploads, password reset). Not all deployments expose these paths publicly; treat as repo paths.
- [DB migrations (source)](/supabase/migrations): SQL migrations defining schema and RLS policies.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): If present, lists indexable pages for crawling.
- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawling rules if present.
